sections.label: J
sections.title: Circle the correct answer.
sections.note: Choose the tag question that correctly completes each sentence.

questions.prompt: 1. You want to be class president, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement is affirmative in the present simple, so the tag is negative: don't you?

questions.prompt: 2. You'll come and listen to my speech, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement uses affirmative will, so the tag uses negative won't.

questions.prompt: 3. He can't come to the council meeting, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement is negative with can't, so the tag is affirmative: can he?

questions.prompt: 4. She was a volunteer, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement is affirmative with was, so the tag is negative: wasn't she?

sections.label: K
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Write the correct tag question.
sections.note: Use the auxiliary and subject from each statement, and reverse positive and negative.

questions.prompt: 1. She is the class president, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement is affirmative with is, so the tag is negative: isn't she?

questions.prompt: 2. You didn't meet the mayor yesterday, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement is negative with didn't, so the tag is affirmative: did you?

questions.prompt: 3. You are an assistant, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement is affirmative with are, so the tag is negative: aren't you?

questions.prompt: 4. You don't like giving speeches, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement is negative with don't, so the tag is affirmative: do you?

questions.prompt: 5. He won a contest, ___?
questions.explanation: Won is past simple, so the negative tag uses didn't: didn't he?

questions.prompt: 6. They are going to the play, ___?
questions.explanation: The statement is affirmative with are, so the tag is negative: aren't they?
